purpose: Require learned components to improve both historical comparable OOF and rows without exact-text or exact-first-image connected components crossing folds

connected_safe_gate.training_rule_for_local_methods: Rows in components spanning historical folds cannot be used as donors, prototypes, hard negatives, gate-training rows or selection rows

topology_repeat_gate.acceptance: All three repeated grouped topologies have positive Macro delta, their mean delta is at least 0.003, and at least 11 of 15 category-combined folds improve
topology_repeat_gate.expensive_pretrained_component_rule: If retraining all foundation adapters on repeats is disproportionate, fixed OOF candidate predictions may only provide topology-dispersion evidence and cannot satisfy this gate for a new local head

stochastic_repeat.acceptance: Positive mean delta across the two repeated folds and no category drop over 0.005 on both full and connected-safe rows

known_limitations: This is a sealed exclusion guard over historical folds, not a fully retrained connected-component split for expensive LoRA baselines.
It removes exact normalized-text and exact first-image embedding paths but not every near-duplicate or hidden distribution shift.
Retrospective audits calibrate trust and cannot promote previously rejected candidates.
